## 1. Passwords and Access
- Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory on every company account.

- USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops.
- Client data must never be stored on personal devices.

# Tarnwick Travel Policy

Version 1.1 - Effective 1 April 2026 - Owner: Operations

## 1. Booking
All business travel is booked through the TravelDesk team at travel@tarnwick.example. Flights must be requested at least 14 days before departure. Requests made later need written approval from your line manager.

## 2. Approval
Trips costing up to PKR 100,000 in total are approved by the line manager. Trips above PKR 100,000, and all international trips, need approval from the Operations Director.

## 3. Daily Allowances
Meal and hotel limits are set in the Expense and Reimbursement Policy. Employees on international trips receive a daily allowance of USD 60 instead of meal claims.

TARNWICK EMPLOYEE FAQ
Last updated: March 2025

Q: What are the office hours?
A: The Lahore office is open Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM.

Q: How many annual leave days do I get?
A: Full-time employees get 18 days of annual leave per year.

Q: Who do I contact for HR questions?
A: Email hr@tarnwick.example or message the #ask-hr channel on Slack.

Q: My laptop is broken. What should I do?
A: Raise a ticket in the IT Help Desk on Jira. Replacement laptops are issued within 3 working days.

Q: Which public holidays does Tarnwick follow?
A: Tarnwick follows the federal public holiday list announced by the Government of Pakistan.

Q: Is there a referral bonus?
A: Yes. You receive PKR 50,000 when a person you referred completes probation.

Version 2.1 - Effective 1 January 2026 - Owner: Operations

# 1. Hybrid Schedule

After probation, employees work in a hybrid pattern: 3 days in the Lahore office and 2 days from home.

Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday are mandatory office days.

Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 16:00 Pakistan Standard Time. Employees must be reachable on Slack during core hours.

# 3. Fully Remote Periods

Employees may work fully remote for up to 2 weeks per quarter with line manager approval.

Working from outside Pakistan is allowed for up to 30 days per calendar year and needs written HR approval.

# Tarnwick Security and IT Policy

Version 3.0 - Effective 1 February 2026 - Owner: IT and Security

## 1. Passwords and Access
- Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory on every company account.
- Store all work passwords in the company Bitwarden vault. Never share passwords over Slack or email.

## 2. Devices
- All company laptops use full-disk encryption (BitLocker).
- Security patches must be installed within 7 days of release.
- USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops.
- Client data must never be stored on personal devices.

# Tarnwick Learning and Development Policy

Version 1.2 - Effective 1 January 2026 - Owner: HR Department

## 1. Annual Budget
Every confirmed full-time employee has a learning budget of PKR 150,000 per calendar year. Unused budget does not roll over.

## 2. Learning Days
Employees receive 5 paid learning days per year for courses, conferences or exam preparation. Learning days are separate from annual leave.

## 3. Certifications
Certification exam fees are reimbursed after you pass the exam. Approved certifications include Salesforce, HubSpot, AWS and project management credentials. A failed exam is reimbursed once if the retake is passed within 6 months.
